expected_direction.compile_fx_wrapper: decrease by roughly the pass delta

rationale: The primary study's profiler traces on WB showed _patch_retiled_load_indexes doing repeated pairwise scans of a growing candidate list. The reverse-adjacency prototype restructures those into a single-pass forward-adjacency walk, keeping the same output edges. On WB_n4 (Lk=4096, kv_block=1024) and WB_n8 (Lk=4096, kv_block=512), we expected ~3x speedup at n=4 and larger at n=8 due to superlinear scaling of the old code.
